title: LokaUtils
description: Loka Based Mod with cool info and features (courtesy of the loka API)
body:
Uses the Loka API to provide stats and data to Loka players about Loka, and also has built in features (like muteondeath) to assist the player experience. If you want to possibly prevent yourself from getting muted for toxicity or some vulgar things, and also want to have useful Loka-related information available conveniently, this mod is for you.

**Current Features:**

**Town Search** - Basic Town Search Functions: name, strength values, member count, level, vulnerability period. (will be improved in future)

**Mute On Death** - Doesn't allow you to type or see messages after dying (to prevent salty post-cove death chat rampages)

**Fish Tracker** - Allows you to collect data on fishing trips on Loka. This is a pre-release feature currently and has its bugs. (1.21.11 only)
